# Standard GRC Platform

> API-first agentic GRC platform for compliance assessments powered by the Secure Controls Framework (SCF). 7 specialized AI agents, 1,468 controls, 231 frameworks.

## Docs

- [Functional Guide](https://standard-api.bekaa.eu/docs/api/GUIDE.md): Architecture, concepts, assessment lifecycle, AI agents
- [API Reference](https://standard-api.bekaa.eu/docs/api/API_REFERENCE.md): Full endpoint documentation with auth, errors, rate limits
- [Full Context for LLMs](https://standard-api.bekaa.eu/llms-full.txt): Complete API context in a single file
- [OpenAPI Spec (JSON)](https://standard-api.bekaa.eu/docs/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specification
- [Interactive Docs](https://standard-api.bekaa.eu/docs): Scalar API explorer with try-it-out

## API

Base URL: `https://standard-api.bekaa.eu`
Auth: Bearer API key (`standard_live_...`) or session cookie. The API Key automatically resolves to your Root Tenant.
Tenant: Implicitly resolved via API Key. Use `organization_id` in paths for Sub-Tenant isolation.

- [Webhooks](#webhooks): Event-driven integrations
